title: rhabdadenia latifolia
intro: Rhabdadenia latifolia, commonly known as the "Coral Honeysuckle," is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Rhabdadenia latifolia include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
